statedReasoning: Government omnibus bill (predkladatel: Ministry of Finance / Deputy PM and Finance Minister Alena Schillerová) amending zákon č. 256/2004 Sb., o podnikání na kapitálovém trhu, and related laws, implementing EU financial-market rules. Having now read the actual bill text (Čl. I), the amendment directly cites, in its own footnote updates, CELEX 32024L2810 (Directive (EU) 2024/2810 on multiple-vote-share structures for companies seeking admission to trading on an MTF), CELEX 32024L2811 (the EU 'Listing Act' directive proper) and CELEX 32024L2994 (amending EMIR-related central-counterparty concentration-risk rules) -- i.e. this is the primary domestic implementing vehicle for the EU Listing Act package plus an EMIR-adjacent risk-management update. Confirmed concrete changes include: removing the 'plná svéprávnost' (full legal capacity) qualifying condition in multiple provisions governing who may hold controlling/managing roles at a securities trader (§6, §28a, §30, §38); a new §6(1)(m) exemption allowing an investment firm's other (non-investment-service) business as long as it poses no material threat to the firm's financial stability or effective supervision; new central-counterparty concentration-risk planning duties (§12ab, §12ad) tied to EU Regulation (EU) 648/2012 (EMIR); and a redefinition of 'investment research' (§15ca) tightening/clarifying the research-unbundling payment rules. This matches and substantiates the independent Ministry of Finance press release, which additionally describes simplified prospectus rules, relaxed investment-research restrictions, removal of Czech 'gold-plating' beyond EU minimums (incl. dropping mandatory ČNB registration for certain broker ancillary activities), and new bond-investor warning language. Stated goal per the ministry: increase Czech capital-market attractiveness for SMEs while strengthening bond-investor safeguards.
researchedContext: This is the batch's clearest data-quality finding: the graph's title-regex only recorded 256/2004 Sb. as amended, but the census (undercount=5) shows the bill actually amends SIX real statutes: 256/2004 (capital markets), 15/1998 (dohled v oblasti kapitálového trhu -- capital market supervision), 190/2004 (dluhopisy -- bonds), 21/1992 (banky -- banking act), 87/1995 (spořitelní a úvěrní družstva -- savings/credit unions), and 90/2012 (obchodní korporace -- business corporations). This matches independently: the extracted PDF text names amendments to the banking act, savings/credit-union act, capital-market-supervision act, securities/bonds law, and business-corporations act as Articles III-IX -- i.e. the census's real-law list and the PDF's own article structure agree, which is strong corroboration this is a genuine omnibus undercount, not a census artifact. Legislative history independently confirms: submission and Chamber distribution 25 Mar 2026 (registered in eKLEP), Organizational Committee proceeding recommendation 2 Apr 2026 (rapporteur Ing. Libor Turek, Ph.D., Budget Committee as guarantor), first reading 14 Jul 2026 (24th/27th session, resolution 260 assigning it to committees), and as of 24 Jul 2026 the Budget Committee has not yet examined it; six amendments are pending.
